experiment.title: 16-bit projective shared-sign scaling and weighted cost
experiment.objective: Test whether the projective homogeneous zero-locator signal survives two fresh 16-bit prime-field curves with explicit weighted arithmetic and downstream relation accounting.

inputs.operator: shared-Z Jacobian P+S/P-S with homogeneous Z^12 norm predicate

stopping_rules: charge projective predicate and cache costs
report weighted costs separately from point-add structure
do not promote relation/rank evidence to individual-log descent
do not promote toy evidence to an exponent claim
invalidation_rules: invalidate if clean verifier or rho certificates fail
do not hide family-specific rank loss
experiment.success_criterion: Full controls and independent verification pass on both fresh 16-bit curves; source_prf_x passes a registered sub-full budget and projective weighted arithmetic cost is below both comparators for all inversion weights.
experiment.falsification_criterion: Any arithmetic/support/rank failure, weighted cost reversal, or verifier failure.
